---
title: "Embeddings and Single-Cell Case Study"
---

## Core Question

Why are modern embeddings useful but easy to overinterpret?

## Lesson Scaffold

- Treat embeddings as neighborhood-preserving summaries.
- Compare t-SNE and UMAP at the level of objectives and tradeoffs.
- Discuss hyperparameters and instability.
- Explain why visual clusters are not automatically biological cell types.
- Start from matrix preprocessing in a single-cell workflow.
- Use PCA before neighborhood graphs.
- Separate clustering from annotation.
- Treat cell labels as claims, not raw data.
